AaaS widget — font-load smoke test

Widget loads from ./widget.js. The host page declares font-family: "Noto Sans Oriya"…. If the bundled font activates, the two probes below will render with identical glyph shapes (Noto Sans Oriya). If the host-page injection fails, the first probe falls back to Kalinga / system fonts.

Probe A (host page — picks up injected @font-face):

ଓଡ଼ିଶା ଓ ଭାରତ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରବେଶଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା

Probe B (explicit conjuncts — ରା, ଷ୍ଟ, ଜ୍ଞ, ଦ୍ୱ):

ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର, ଜ୍ଞାନ, ଦ୍ୱାର, ଶ୍ରୀ, କ୍ଷମା, ଚ୍ୟୁ

Open devtools → Network → filter "font". You should see no font request to fonts.gstatic.com — the font is inlined in widget.js. If the widget loaded, you'll see a round ଅ button at bottom-right.
